portal_description:
The Pacemaker cluster resource manager is a collection of technologies working together to maintain data integrity and application availability in the event of failures. 

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* pacemaker should use DBus signalling rather than polling for systemd resource start/stop [rhel-9.6.z] (JIRA:RHEL-92505)

* Add option for controlling remote node fencing behavior [rhel-9.6.z] (JIRA:RHEL-92513)

The Pacemaker cluster resource manager is a collection of technologies working together to maintain data integrity and application availability in the event of failures.

* Add option for controlling remote node fencing behavior [rhel-9.6.z] (JIRA:RHEL-92513)
